title: [TEST] Handle error in concurrent downsample actions

timeline.author: Kostas Krikellas

-  method: testDuplicateDownsampleRequest
-  issue: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/122158
 - class: org.elasticsearch.search.SearchCancellationIT
   method: testCancelFailedSearchWhenPartialResultDisallowed
   issue: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/121719

timeline.body:
The reported test failure indicates that there are two identical persistent tasks proceeding, which is not an issue with the downsample action (this shouldn't be happening).

Fixes #122158

A persistent task with the same id/name should result in a `ResourceAlreadyExistsException`. However maybe it is wrapped in another exception and that is why the test failed. I think just catching a parent exception is ok here. We could also maybe unwrap the cause? (`ExceptionsHelper`)

reply.body: The log shows that actually both tasks ran, somehow.. The exception is from the second task failing to write to the target index, as it's marked as read-only by the first one after populating it. I'm not sure how it is possible to have both tasks to run, couldn't reproduce it.
